_comment: Cars drawn from the template layers (livery card, phase 1). Template measurements are sprite pixels on the 256x512 layers: tyre centres from the card, car extent measured (x 42-213, y 6-494). The sprite is scaled so carLengthPx = physics car.lengthM and centred on the car body. helmet: shadows-layer pixels in this hue range (degrees) with at least minChroma (max-min channel) become the tintable helmet (433 px). shadow: generated soft drop shadow, offset and blur in sprite pixels. playerHelmet: your helmet; AI drivers use their team's colors.helmet.
